cues.text: Let's say attendance for a class has already been taken today, and you need to fix a mistake. Here's how to do that safely, without creating duplicates.
Open Manual Entry from the Attendance menu, then pick the same class and the same date.
Notice the blue message. It tells you that records already exist for this date, so saving will update them rather than create new ones.
The saved statuses load automatically. If a student was marked wrongly, just tap their status to change it.
Now press Save Attendance. The confirmation says the records were updated, and nothing was created twice.
That's it. Corrections are safe, so you can fix attendance any time without worrying about duplicates.
